reviews.title: This tuner sucks
reviews.text: This tuner sucks. Don’t waste your time with it. The app isn’t intuitive at all and it’s not free.

reviews.title: Intrusive Ads
reviews.text: Every now and then, the app will interrupt the tuning screen and move to an upselling screen trying to get you to subscribe. Ads under the tuner are fine, interrupting me to subscribe is absolutely unacceptable. Use this app for years and am tired of it. Moving to a different app.

reviews.text: Fake Kalimba sounds terrible no matter how u try to tune it. This app is just as terrible as the kalimba

reviews.title: No support for this app
reviews.text: I have the free app. It doesn’t work. There is no support-none, not even a help button. I would have liked at least some instruction on how to use the app.
